{% autoescape off %}# {{ site_name }}

> A dashboard of the contributor community of PyCalendar: projects, which are sets of repositories on GitHub, with their issues and pull requests. Every public page has its JSON: read the JSON, not the HTML.

The JSON is at the address of a page with `.json` instead of the last `/`. It holds what a visitor who is not signed in sees, it allows every site (CORS), and it needs no sign-in or token. Errors are JSON too, with `error`, `title`, `detail` and `documentation`.

How to navigate: start at {{ site_url }}/projects.json, take the `slug` of a project, then read {{ site_url }}/projects/<slug>.json and {{ site_url }}/projects/<slug>/pull-requests.json. A project lists its repositories; the pull requests link to GitHub (`url`).

Be kind to the site: it is small. Read a page once, follow the pages of a list (`page`, `pages`) one after the other, and do not open the pages of robots.txt that are not allowed. The data is as fresh as the last update of the project (`updated`).

## The JSON of the pages
